newsitem.title: USA: Euro heating needs above normal early in week--WSC.
newsitem.headline: Euro heating needs above normal early in week--WSC.

text.p: The cold weather spell is forecast to persist in Europe early this week, with energy usage for heating well above normal, private forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said.
Energy usage for heating may diminish later in the week, WSC added.
Transportation problems on the rivers of central Europe will continue due to a build up of ice, it said.

In northwest Europe, temperatures will be 10-15 degrees Fahrenheit below normal Monday and Tuesday, and 3-8 below on Wednesday and Thursday. In the northeast, temperatures will be 8-15 below normal Monday and Tuesday, and 4-8 below on Wednesday and Thursday.
Energy usage for heating in the U.S. northeast is forecast near to somewhat above normal this week.
Temperatures in the U.S. northeast will be 6-10 above normal Monday, cooling to 2-4 below on Tuesday and Wednesday, and mostly near normal on Thursday.
